adu.ours: Allowed by Zoning Permit with owner-occupancy on lots of at least 10,000 sq ft, in every district that permits single-family (ADU definition, Sec. 4)

notes: NZA shows 17.6% of residential land where 4+-family housing may be allowed after a hearing; Appendix A of the 2024 code shows none, and the difference is unexplained.
NZA codes every 1-family acre as ADU-prohibited; the 2024 code allows ADUs by zoning permit with owner occupancy on lots of at least 10,000 sq ft.
Our shares use gross district acres; NZA removes protected and unzoned land.
stamford.method: Recomputed from the town's mirrored zoning code and our district acreage, using NZA's own definitions (share of residential land by status; 1-family minimum-lot bins; parking mandate share) and the proxy formula (0.30 x mean of 2-, 3-, 4+-family prohibited + 0.25 x large-lot share + 0.15 x parking share) / 0.70.

adu.ours: Allowed by zoning permit (administrative approval from the Planning and Zoning Office) with owner-occupancy, in RA-4, RA-2, RA-1, R-20, R-12, R-7 and R-6; oversize ADUs or ADUs on nonconforming lots need a special permit.
adu.nza: NZA codes 87.5% of 1-family land as allowed with occupancy restrictions and 12.4% prohibited

notes: Stored NZA inputs were checked against NZA's live snapshot on 2026-11-02 and match it (parking 100%, large-lot 65.0%).
Single-family parking (Sec. 6-154) requires 'sufficient' spaces with no number, so we count it as a mandate; NZA's 92% probably counts only numeric minimums.
1,229 acres of conservation, R-PR and R-PHD zones are unclassified because their text is not mirrored.
